title: Review and approval

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Make the release checkpoint explicit so partners know when execution needs review before becoming public.
strategic_value: A defined review step can help catch trademark and hierarchy mistakes before IBM appears in published material.
demonstration: A short approval paragraph occupies the left portion of an otherwise open page beneath its title.
practical_value: Submit the planned communication to the IBM contact before printing or posting it.

content_islands.name: Approval heading
content_islands.spec: Place Review and approval at upper left.

content_islands.name: Release requirement
content_islands.spec: Set the short paragraph below, retaining the qualified typical response time of 72 hours.

reference_purposes.Application: The source names the IBM contact as the review route and states a typical response time.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Communications featuring IBM trademarks must be submitted before printing or posting. The 72-hour response is qualified as in most cases, not guaranteed.
